expected_behavior: Detects MD-1801 as a Jira ticket (not a GitHub issue) from the KEY-NUMBER format and looks it up to use as the spec
Runs the bundled scripts/start-ticket.sh to create the branch and worktree rather than hand-rolling the git worktree and branch-naming steps
Transitions the Jira ticket to In Progress and moves into the new worktree to begin the implementation
Scaffolds the workspace and kicks off work only: it does not commit, promote to dev/prod, or open a PR (those are separate lifecycle skills)
